summary: First-party Codex image generation plugin shipping a legacy Action Card plus a native Generator Definition over one transport-neutral PluginModule.
context_hints: Keep Codex CLI execution in the Clash host tool; plugin code calls context.hostTools.codexImagegen.generate
Do not add API-key fallbacks: this Action intentionally uses the user's existing Codex sign-in
Keep generated bytes project-scoped by returning the asset handle from the typed host tool

subdirectories.cards: User-facing Action Card parameters and reference-image constraints.
subdirectories.generators: Native clash.generator/v1 Definition. The Local Host HTTP surface can create/read/run it and enforces its fork-when-materialized edit policy; CLI/MCP/GUI clients remain unwired.
subdirectories.src: Transport-neutral PluginModule plus its compatibility stdio entrypoint and protocol tests.
subdirectories.dist: Generated standalone install artifact; never hand-edit.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.cards/codex-imagegen.json: Marketplace Action Card and aspect-ratio controls.
key_files.generators/codex-imagegen.json: Native fork-when-materialized Generator Definition with one generate Action and one Media output.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: Exports the inert first-party PluginModule and starts the same module over stdio only when executed directly.
